scheme_name: Scheme of Grant-in-Aid to Voluntary and other Organizations Working for Scheduled Castes
other_conditions: Organization must be registered under the Societies Registration Act, 1860, a public trust, a charitable company under Section 25 of the Companies Act, 1956, the Indian Red Cross Society or any other public body with legal status
Organization must have been registered for at least three years (the Ministry may waive this requirement in exceptional cases)
At least 60% of the beneficiaries must belong to the Scheduled Castes for voluntary organizations
The organization must have maintained a bank account in its own name for the last three years
The organization must not operate for profit for any individual or body of individuals, except training institutions of repute
Must have a minimum of two years of experience in the relevant field

Projects must be located in Educationally Backward Blocks (EBBs), Service Deficient blocks with ≥40% SC population, or Backward/Integrated Action Plan districts identified by the Planning Commission or Government of India
Organization must demonstrate financial viability to contribute its share and continue work without Ministry assistance
Must have good reputation, capability to mobilize the community, and networking with other institutions
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance to voluntary organisations for educational, health, childcare, capacity‑building and other livelihood‑generating activities benefitting Scheduled Castes
documents_required: Checklist of required documents (as per the website)
